configuration.query: What opportunities were lost this quarter and what was the total lost revenue
configuration.rephrase: The query will list out those opportunities where estimatedclosedate is this quarter and statecode is lost, then sum over the estimatedvalue as the total lost revenue.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT SUM([estimatedValue]) AS [totalLostRevenue] FROM [Opportunity] WHERE ([actualCloseDate] = 'this quarter') AND ([stateCode] = 'lost')
